missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Зима' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Холодная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'в России' gives the prepositional place.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Зиму' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'. 'Снежную' agrees in the feminine accusative. A natural way to state a seasonal preference.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Зимы' is the genitive of 'зима' depending on 'начала'. The phrase 'ждём начала зимы' means we await the start of winter.

missions.phrase: К зиме мы купили тёплые куртки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative of time. 'Зиме' is the dative of 'зима' after 'к', meaning in preparation for winter. 'Тёплые куртки' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of time. 'Зимой' is the instrumental of 'зима' used adverbially to mean in winter. 'Дети' is the subject and 'на коньках' gives the activity.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Зиме' is the prepositional of 'зима' after 'о'. The impersonal 'написано' reports that many poems exist on the topic.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Зима' is the feminine nominative subject of 'наступила'. The verb agrees in feminine gender, and 'рано' adds timing.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of time. 'Зимой' is the instrumental of 'зима' meaning this past winter. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, and 'много снега' uses the genitive of quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Зимы' is the nominative plural of 'зима' as the subject of 'были'. 'Последние' agrees in the plural, and 'тёплыми' is the instrumental predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Зимы' is the accusative plural of the inanimate 'зима', the object of 'помню'. 'Холодные сибирские' agree in the plural.
